messages:
samir: FYI — after we bumped drivers to CUDA 14.2 on the canary A100 pool, we're seeing a clear perf shift. p99 token latency up ~10% for seq lengths in the 256-512 range. Autotuner started picking `fused-attn-v2` for those seqs; prior to the driver bump it consistently picked `matmul-split-kv` which was ~8-12% faster in our runs. Repro and short traces below.

jia: Can you paste the perf markers and a minimal repro? Also, any KV-cache anomalies? Could be KVCACHE eviction behavior changing kernel path heuristics.

samir: Repro (micro-benchmark run on canary A100):
```
# simple gen loop (batch=4)
seq=256 -> median token 7.2ms, p99 18.6ms, kernel=fused-attn-v2
seq=512 -> median 9.1ms, p99 23.4ms, kernel=fused-attn-v2
seq=1024 -> median 21.4ms, p99 48.3ms, kernel=matmul-split-kv
```
Added nvprof markers show higher SM utilization but worse IPC for fused-attn-v2 at 256/512.
KV-cache: no observable extra evictions in the runs; kv cache hit rate stable.

perf-bench: I ran a quick comparison on H100 and A100. H100 benefits from fused-attn consistently; A100's fused-attn-v2 has a regression in our compiled kernel paths under the new driver. Numbers align with samir's: H100 fine, A100 regresses for mid seq lengths.

emma: Sounds like driver upgrade changed kernel heuristics or the compiled kernel behavior. Two options: (A) rollback driver on canary A100 hosts, (B) enforce runtime kernel policy to prefer matmul-split-kv for seq < 768 on A100s while we dig in. Preference B is lower blast radius and immediate mitigation in hosted.

matt: +1 for B as quick mitigation. Proposed plan:
1) Push runtime override to canary A100 cluster: set kernel_policy = {
   "arch": "A100",
   "seq_thresholds": [256, 768],
   "preferred_kernels": ["matmul-split-kv", "fused-attn-v2"]
}
2) Rollback driver on a single rack (if B fails) — keep as fallback.
3) Collect 48h telemetry (p50/p95/p99, per-seq histogram, kernel picks) and decide.

samir: Here's the exact runtime config I tested locally and that restored perf:
```
# runtime override (canary)
redwood.runtime.kernel_override = "arch:A100; seq:<768 -> matmul-split-kv; else fused-attn-v2"
```
Applying that on the canary service lowered p99 back to baseline in my local staging run.

jia: Who's owning the full rollback plan if we need to roll driver back? I'll help with the autotuner fix.

emma: matt -> you own the canary runtime flag rollout and monitoring. samir & jia -> dig into why fused-attn-v2 regressed under CUDA 14.2 on A100; try reproducing with different nvcc flags / cuBLAS versions. perf-bench -> run ablation to isolate which kernel change (fusion, shared mem tiling, load/store) causes perf drop.

infra-bot: [canary-deploy] 1850002100: canary pool status: 12 hosts (A100) on cuda-14.2, 3 on cuda-13.x. Current traffic routing: 10% -> cuda-14.2 hosts.

perf-bench: Quick additional note — KV cache interaction might still be relevant: when we see heavily interleaved short vs long requests, the autotuner's sequence-bucket sampler shifts frequency and may prefer the kernel that optimizes for a heavier long tail. Need to add seq-bucket weighted sampling in autotuner to stabilize picks.

matt: I'll push the runtime override to canary at 1850003000 and raise the routing to 20% only if we see no regressions in the next 30m. If override doesn't fix within 30 mins, we trigger rack-level driver rollback to 535.xx (pin) and escalate.

samir: I'll start the kernel-level bisect (diffing fused-attn-v2 changes) and open a short PR to add a quick autotuner guard: prefer legacy kernel if perf delta > 5% for 3 consecutive sampling windows.

emma: Thanks. Let's keep updates in this thread. :eyes:

matt: pushed override to canary at 1850003000. monitoring dashboard link: https://console/redwood/perf/canary?run=1850003000

samir: after override applied, canary p99 for seq256 dropped from 18.6ms -> 16.0ms in first 10m sampling. Still watching. Will report back with bisect results.

infra-bot: [alert-suppressed] we've muted automated regressions for this canary group while the override is in place.

jia: I'll prototype a small autotuner patch today and submit for review. If anyone sees a delta in kv-hit patterns, ping me.

emma: Great work. We'll follow the plan: override -> 48h telem -> decide on driver rollback vs autotuner patch.
